state_space.description: LTI system representation: compact form for analysis & control design

pid_control.latex: u(t) = K_p e(t) + K_i \int e(\tau) d\tau + K_d \frac{de}{dt}
pid_control.description: PID controller: proportional, integral, derivative terms

steady_state_error.description: Steady-state error of a unity-feedback proportional loop to a step

settling_time.description: Approximate 2% settling time of an underdamped second-order system

stability.description: Continuous-time LTI stability criterion on the poles of A
stability.validation: All eigenvalues of A in left half-plane

mass_spring_damper_damping_ratio.description: Damping ratio of the mass-spring-damper: underdamped below 1, critical at 1, overdamped above 1
mass_spring_damper_damping_ratio.validation: Regime classification and pole locations match the characteristic polynomial

mass_spring_damper_overshoot.description: Percent overshoot of the unit step response of an underdamped second-order system
mass_spring_damper_overshoot.validation: Simulated overshoot matches the formula at zeta = 0.1 (72.92%)

bode_resonance_peak.description: Peak magnitude of the second-order frequency response for zeta below 1/sqrt(2)
bode_resonance_peak.validation: Grid peak of the magnitude matches M_r within 0.01 dB

bode_bandwidth_3db.description: -3 dB bandwidth of the second-order prototype
bode_bandwidth_3db.validation: Grid crossing of 1/sqrt(2) matches the formula to 0.1%
